BiblicalUsage: Ephod is the father of Hanniel, a chief of the tribe of Manasseh named when the land was divided. He appears once, at the dividing of the inheritance, as the man whose son helped apportion the promise.
TheologicalSignificance: The work of dividing God's gift took real men with real names, and God recorded them. I believe Ephod's one mention is enough to show that no part in the apportioning of the promise was beneath God's notice.
